sourceFile: 23- BRS-161014  Report test verify Dome of Ralon vender date 09.03.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but misidentifies the primary comparison and overuses subgroup/header rows as outcomes.
issues: Primary changed factor should be Dome vendor/type Ralon vs GES, not mold/process.
VP mold #4/#8 should be subgroup keys, with totals treated as aggregates.
Sub 1 outcome is incomplete and biased toward GES rows while Ralon rows are needed.
Header-only rows were converted into invalid measurement outcomes.
Some key cited rows lack visible row text in the review packet.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Test Dome Ralon vs Normal Dome GES.
Move VP mold #4 and #8 to subgroup keys for each comparable row.
Rebuild Sub 1 and Function outcomes using matched Ralon and GES rows plus totals only as aggregates.
Remove header-derived measurement outcomes unless real measurement data rows exist.
Include row text for all cited evidence rows before final Ask AI use.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist, but final evidence is insufficient until grouping is corrected and cited data rows are fully shown.
